messages.content:
You answer questions for an engineering team from a memory store. The user message holds the memory you may use, then the question.
Rules:
- Answer only from the memory provided. Do not use outside knowledge and do not guess.
- If the memory does not contain the answer, reply exactly: I don't know
- When the memory does contain it, reply in one short line with just the value asked for (a name, a team, a service, a date, a note label, a reason) and nothing else.
- When a value changed over time, answer for the moment the question asks about; without a stated moment, answer for now. Today is 2026-06-30.
- Memory entries carry the date they were recorded. Treat a later entry as superseding an earlier one on the same subject.

Memory:
- As of 2025-06-16, Team Boreal has taken over the catalog service from Team Dune. [valid 2025-06-16 to now; recorded by handover/2025-06-16-catalog]
    earlier: Team Dune owns the catalog service as of the 2025-03-20 ownership transfer. [valid 2025-03-20 to 2025-06-16; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
    earlier: Team Cinder owns the catalog service. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-03-20; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17]
- As of 2025-03-20, the pager for the catalog service rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-03-20 to now; recorded by handover/2025-03-20-catalog]
- On 2025-04-04, Team Dune agreed that the catalog service will keep image metadata in a separate table. [decision; valid 2025-04-04 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-04-04]
- On 2025-11-06, Team Dune reported that the indexer's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2025-11-06 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-06]
- As of 2025-12-08, the indexer lives with Team Dune; Team Cinder kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
    earlier: The indexer lives with Team Cinder. [valid 2025-01-17 to 2025-12-08; recorded by standup/cinder/2025-01-17-2]
- As of 2025-10-15, the scheduler is owned by Team Dune; Team Atlas kept it until then. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler went to Team Atlas, not Team Cinder; Team Cinder never owned it, and the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-09-05 to 2025-10-15; recorded by handover/2025-09-05-scheduler-correction]
    earlier: As of 2025-08-29, the scheduler is owned by Team Cinder; the Ember team no longer owns it. [valid 2025-08-29 to 2025-09-05; recorded by handover/2025-08-29-scheduler]
    earlier: The scheduler is owned by the Ember team. [valid 2025-01-20 to 2025-08-29; recorded by standup/ember/2025-01-20]
- On 2025-12-17, Team Dune's standup decided that the indexer will rebuild the index nightly instead of on every catalog write. [decision; valid 2025-12-17 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-12-17]
- As of 2025-12-08, the pager for the indexer rings Team Dune instead of Team Cinder. [valid 2025-12-08 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-08-search-indexer]
- As of 2026-06-08, Farah is the primary on-call for Team Dune. [valid 2026-06-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Tomasz Nowak is the primary on-call for Team Dune. [valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-06-08; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-13]
- As of 2026-03-10, Farah is the primary on-call for Team Dune for this cycle. [valid 2026-03-10 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-03-10]
- As of 2025-10-15, the pager for the scheduler rings Team Dune instead of Team Atlas. [valid 2025-10-15 to now; recorded by handover/2025-10-15-scheduler]
- As of January 2025, Team Dune consists of Farah alone. [valid 2025-01-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-01-09]
- On 2025-11-21, Team Dune reported that the billing service's queue depth hit 50,000 after the marketing send. [valid 2025-11-21 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-11-21]
- As of 2025-03-24, Farah still has the Team Dune pager. [valid 2025-03-24 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-03-24]
- As of 2026-05-26, the billing service sits with Team Dune; Team Boreal no longer owns it. [valid 2026-05-26 to now; recorded by handover/2026-05-26-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Boreal as of the 2025-03-17 handover. [valid 2025-03-17 to 2026-05-26; recorded by handover/2025-03-17-billing-api]
    earlier: The billing service lives with Team Atlas. [valid 2025-01-08 to 2025-03-17; recorded by standup/atlas/2025-01-08]
- Farah is the release captain for Team Dune for Q3 2025. [valid 2025-10-22 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-10-22-2]
- Team Dune has switched to a monthly game day. [decision; valid 2025-05-09 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2025-05-09-2]
- As of 2026-06-08, Farah is back on the Team Dune on-call rotation as the primary on-call. [valid 2026-06-08 to now; recorded by standup/dune/2026-06-08]
    earlier: As of 2026-04-13, Farah is off the Team Dune on-call rotation. [valid 2026-04-13 to 2026-06-08; recorded by standup/dune/2026-04-13]
- As of 2025-12-01, the resizer lives with Team Dune; the Ember team kept it until then. [valid 2025-12-01 to now; recorded by handover/2025-12-01-image-resizer]
